ablation_findings.scaling_analysis: Execution latency for ledger construction and verification scales linearly O(N) with event count under fixed batch size.
ablation_findings.batch_size_tradeoff: Larger batch sizes reduce total block header count and serialization overhead, while increasing the Merkle tree depth per block log2(B).

security_and_distributed_systems_boundar: All measurements reflect an in-memory, single-node Python implementation on the local host. These benchmarks evaluate cryptographic data structure efficiency (canonical serialization, SHA-256, Merkle trees). They do NOT establish distributed consensus throughput, P2P network gossip latency, or Byzantine fault tolerance.
